name: deal.stage
description: Weekly pipeline review: is this deal real, what stage is it in, and what is the next step. Input is one deal row -- buyer, firm, problem, evidence of budget or authority, last activity date, and the recorded next step.

stage.instructions: The true stage of this deal from the evidence in the row, not from the label someone gave it

criteria.new_lead: No conversation yet -- a name and a contact route only
criteria.discovery: First conversation happened, problem discussed, nothing scoped
criteria.scoped: A specific deliverable or workflow is scoped and the buyer has seen it
criteria.proposal_ready: Pricing or a proposal is written and ready to go to the buyer
criteria.verbal_commit: Buyer has said yes in principle and the paperwork is the only step left
criteria.closed_won: Signed or paid -- the deal is done
criteria.closed_lost: Dead: the buyer declined, went dark past the agreed date, or chose someone else
criteria.stalled: Was alive, then stopped moving without a decision in either direction

stale.instructions: This deal has had no meaningful two-way activity in more than 30 days -- no reply, no meeting, no shared document. One-way chase emails do not count as activity.

is_real.instructions: How real this deal is from evidence in the row, not from how good it feels
criteria: No named buyer, no named problem, no budget mention -- a name in a spreadsheet
Named buyer and a general problem, but no evidence of authority or budget
Named buyer, named problem, and a rough timeline; authority or budget unconfirmed
Buyer with authority, named problem, and a budget range or a procurement path
Buyer, problem, budget and a dated mutual next step already agreed

next_step.instructions: A concrete next step is recorded with an owner and a date -- 'follow up soon' or 'waiting on them' does not count.

rules.reason: stale more than 30 days -- decide revive or close, do not let it drift
proposal-ready -- Mike reviews before anything goes to the buyer
closed lost -- drop it out of the active pipeline view
not a real deal yet -- qualify it properly or drop it
no dated next step -- a deal without one is already drifting

notes.ranking: is_real.score (0..4) is the pipeline-quality number; the stage choice is the routing decision.
notes.thresholds: Provisional and uncalibrated; BLOCK rules would report ESCALATE until calibrated (law 3). This pack carries no BLOCK rule on purpose -- closing or killing a deal is always a human decision.
